purpose: Run the author v1.0 TensorFlow model in an isolated legacy environment without changing the Windows project environment.

unresolved_dependencies.name: ssqueezepy
unresolved_dependencies.reason: The author requirements file does not pin a version; selecting one silently could change the SST representation. It is deferred to the Phase-2 preprocessing lock.

runtime_notes: The authoritative WSL distribution identity comes from /etc/os-release (Ubuntu 24.04). Python 3.7 platform.platform() reports a Debian trixie/sid compatibility suffix because /etc/debian_version contains trixie/sid; the probe labels this as non-authoritative compatibility metadata.
WSL2 reports a missing NUMA-node sysfs entry; TensorFlow defaults the GPU to NUMA node 0 and the smoke test passes.
The environment has CUDA runtime libraries but no ptxas compiler, so TensorFlow 2.4 falls back to NVIDIA driver PTX JIT; first-process startup is slow but execution passes.
The successful synthetic smoke batch uses batch size 2 and does not establish that the paper batch size 128 fits in 6 GB VRAM.
comparison_guard: Passing this environment smoke test establishes executable compatibility only; it does not reproduce the reported 83 percent result.
